# MAM Industries

> Precision metal fabrication, 3kW CNC fiber laser cutting, 250-ton CNC press brake bending, MIG/TIG/CO2/laser welding, powder coating, and laser marking in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India.

## Core Capabilities & Tolerances
- **CNC Fiber Laser Cutting**: 3kW fiber laser, 2m x 4m bed size, ±0.1 mm accuracy. Mild Steel (0.8–16 mm), Stainless Steel (0.8–8 mm), Aluminium (0.1–5 mm), Galvanised Iron (0.8–4 mm).
- **CNC Bending**: 250-ton programmable hydraulic press brake, 2500 mm bed length, ±0.05° accuracy. MS up to 8 mm, SS up to 6 mm.
- **Welding**: MIG / CO2 welding, architectural TIG welding, resistance spot & arc welding, and precision fiber laser welding.
- **Surface Finishing & Marking**: Powder coating (RAL colour matching), hot-dip galvanising, electroplating, and permanent fiber laser marking/engraving (QR codes, serial numbers, logos).
- **Turnkey Structures**: Rolling shutters (manual & motorized), industrial security gates & grills, and industrial sheds / PEB structures.
- **Accepted CAD Formats**: .DXF, .DWG, .STEP, .STP, .IGS, and dimensional PDF drawings.
